title: Bennett University Nearest Metro Station: Depot vs Pari Chowk (2026)
meta_title: Bennett University Nearest Metro Station: Depot & Pari Chowk
meta_description: Bennett University nearest metro station is Depot on the Aqua Line, but students use Pari Chowk, 11 km away. Auto ₹150-200, cabs, buses, route from Delhi.
excerpt: Depot is the nearest metro station to Bennett University by distance, but most students use Pari Chowk: about 11 km and ₹150-200 by auto. Station comparison, fares, Bennett buses and the metro route from Delhi, checked September 2026.

faq.question: Which is the nearest metro station to Bennett University?
faq.answer: Depot, the last stop on the Aqua Line, is nearest by distance: about 9-11 km by road depending on direction (5.8 km in a straight line), with GNIDA Office almost as close. Most students use Pari Chowk, about 11 km away, because in my experience autos and app cabs are easier to find there.

faq.question: Bennett University ke nearest metro station kaunsa hai?
faq.answer: Distance ke hisaab se sabse nearest Depot station hai (Aqua Line), lekin zyada students Pari Chowk use karte hain. Pari Chowk se Bennett lagbhag 11 km hai, auto se 20-25 minute aur kiraya ₹150-200. Uber ya Rapido mein lagbhag ₹150-250 lagta hai.

faq.question: How much does an auto cost from Pari Chowk to Bennett University?
faq.answer: Usually ₹150-200, and the ride takes 20-25 minutes. Agree the fare before you get in and try not to pay more than ₹200; prices go up before and during holidays. Uber or Rapido cost about ₹150-250 with the price shown upfront.

faq.question: Does Bennett University run a shuttle to the metro station?
faq.answer: Not a regular one from the stations near campus. Bennett's paid, semester-pass buses for day scholars pick up at stations such as Sector 51, NSEZ and Sector 148, not at Pari Chowk or Depot. A Bennett web page mentions weekend shuttles to the closest metro station, so check with the transport office whether one is running.

faq.question: How do I reach Bennett University from Delhi by metro?
faq.answer: Take the Blue Line towards Noida Electronic City (not Vaishali) to Noida Sector 52, take the skywalk to Noida Sector 51 and ride the Aqua Line to Pari Chowk. From there, an auto, Uber or Rapido covers the last 11 km to campus.

faq.question: What is the distance from Greater Noida Depot metro station to Bennett University?
faq.answer: About 9 km by road going from the station to campus, and about 10-10.7 km going back (5.8 km in a straight line), measured on OpenStreetMap in September 2026.

sources: Author field data (Uttkarsh Thakur, Bennett University hostel resident), 26 Sep 2026: Pari Chowk use, auto ₹150-200 (don't pay over ₹200, higher around holidays), Uber/Rapido ₹150-250, 20-25 min, no shuttle, late-night autos
